desc.zh: 在田间真实环境下，对比秸秆还田、不同化肥、生物调节剂、不施肥这几类管理方式，观测水稻生长、产量、土壤养分、微生物等指标差异，评估不同施肥/培肥方案的农田效应。
desc.en: In the actual field environment, by comparing various management methods such as straw returning to the soil, different fertilizers, biological regulators, and no fertilization, we observe the differences in indicators such as rice growth, yield, soil nutrients, and microorganisms, and evaluate the effects of different fertilization and soil improvement schemes on the farmland.
